<fe><02><0a><37><38><35><62><5f><30><30><38><31><00>I wasn't able to protect
Cierra,<fe><00><fe><02><0a><37><38><35><62><5f><30><30><38><32><00>even after defeating Hector
and saving Riviera.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><37><38><35><62><5f><30><30><38><33><00>Why does it have to end like
this!?

<fe><02><0a><37><38><35><62><5f><30><30><38><34><00>I wasn't able to protect
Serene,<fe><00><fe><02><0a><37><38><35><62><5f><30><30><38><32><00>even after defeating Hector
and saving Riviera.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><37><38><35><62><5f><30><30><38><33><00>Why does it have to end like
this!?
<fe><02><0a><37><39><31><62><5f><30><30><30><30><00>This path goes under\nthe Isle of Goriate...
<fe><02><0a><37><39><31><62><5f><30><30><30><32><00>So this is what's holding\nup this island of darkness?
<fe><02><0a><37><39><31><62><5f><30><30><30><34><00>All I see is darkness...\nAny volunteers to go first?
<fe><02><0a><37><39><33><62><5f><30><30><30><39><00>These scratches look like\nthey're from a sword.
<fe><02><0a><37><39><34><62><5f><30><30><30><32><00>Well, maybe it won't be\na total waste of time.

One end of Heaven's
Gate which has been
tainted by darkness.
Large rocks are
stacked in layers.

A walkway connecting
Heaven's Gate to
the Isle of Goriate.
It's made of rocks
chained together.

The floating island
where Hector's castle
is situated. A barrier
has shrouded the isle
in darkness.

A winding path leading
to the Maze of Shadows,
Hector's castle. The
road is much longer
than it appears.

One of the layers
of the Triple Strata
in the Maze of
Shadows. It's cast
in eerie, red light.

One of the layers
of the Triple Strata
in the Maze of
Shadows. It's cast
in odd, green light.

A layer of the Triple
Strata in the Maze of
Shadows. It's cast in
mysterious, blue
light.

The fourth layer of
the Triple Strata in
the Maze of Shadows,
located within
a dimensional rift.

The fort where Hector
repelled the demon
attack during Ragnarok.
It still bears scars
from the battle.
You are trespassing\nin the Underworld...<fe><00>Your existence is not\npermitted here...
I am Hades.<fe><00>Long have I been sealed\naway in this dark world.
I shall ensure you\nregret having been born.
We don't have a choice...\nGet ready to fight!!
Hades is the...\nKing of the Underworld...

There aren't official
records of it...<fe><00>So I'm not positive,
but I believe he is.<fe><00>He was supposedly sealed
deep within Riviera...
Wow, this is the center\nof Riviera, huh...?

<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><63><5f><30><30><32><34><00>It looks like we've wandered\ninto a strange place...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><38><32><31><63><5f><30><30><32><35><00>Anyways, let's move on.\nWe'll figure it out later.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><63><5f><30><30><32><37><00>There must be a way out.\nLet's all work together.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><63><5f><30><30><37><30><00>There's no telling where enemies\nare hiding in this darkness.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><63><5f><30><30><35><35><00>It's so dark here... I can't\nsee a thing ahead of me.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><32><63><5f><30><30><30><30><00>The air here is heavy.\nHow far does this path go...?
<fe><02><0a><38><32><32><63><5f><30><30><30><31><00><fc><4b>chuckle<fc><4b> You have no future...\nYour journey ends here.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><32><63><5f><30><30><30><34><00>With all this darkness, turning\nback isn't an option.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><32><63><5f><30><30><31><39><00>Can you do it with \nyour magic, Cierra?
<fe><02><0a><38><32><32><63><5f><30><30><32><36><00>We know it's there, but we\ncan't reach it... That sucks!
<fe><02><0a><38><32><32><63><5f><30><30><32><38><00>My, my. Since when did\nyou learn such a move...
<fe><02><0a><38><32><32><63><5f><30><30><33><31><00>But still, there being a\nMana Wisp here means...
<fe><02><0a><38><32><32><63><5f><30><30><33><32><00>There must have been a Sprite\nhere at one point.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><32><63><5f><30><30><35><31><00>Hmhm. What cute guests we have.\nWe'll reap your souls...
<fe><02><0a><38><32><32><63><5f><30><30><36><33><00>The truth will be forever\nlost to you.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><33><63><5f><30><30><30><30><00>Souls who have wandered into\nthe abyss... Expire by my magic.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><33><63><5f><30><30><32><37><00>It'd be trouble if the golem\nwoke up and attacked us.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><38><32><33><63><5f><30><30><32><38><00>We should take it\nout now.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><33><63><5f><30><30><33><33><00>This is a rare opportunity.\nEveryone, attack the golem!
<fe><02><0a><38><32><33><63><5f><30><30><33><38><00>Now is not the time to\nargue. It's coming!
<fe><02><0a><38><32><33><63><5f><30><30><34><34><00>You're supposed to do it so\nthe enemy won't wake up.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><33><63><5f><30><30><37><30><00>You're the only one who picks\nup rocks like they're gold.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><34><63><5f><30><30><31><35><00>I didn't know there was\na trap like that.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><34><63><5f><30><30><32><38><00>I feel kind of bad, but\nwe had no choice.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><34><63><5f><30><30><31><31><00>It looks like some fool\nfell for our trap.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><34><63><5f><30><30><32><39><00>We can attack from afar.\nLina, will you do the honors?
<fe><02><0a><38><32><34><63><5f><30><30><34><35><00>It may be sleeping, but it\nis still hurt.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><34><63><5f><30><30><35><39><00>It doesn't like me...\nSomeone else go first.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><35><63><5f><30><30><30><32><00>Intruders of the chaos realm...\nYou shall pay with your souls.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><35><63><5f><30><30><31><37><00>That was unnerving... I thought\nthe floor would crumble.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><35><63><5f><30><30><34><31><00>Looks like we gotta take it<fc><4a> I\ndon't see anywhere else to go.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><35><63><5f><30><30><34><32><00>You're right. This should lead\nus further into the labyrinth.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><62><5f><30><30><30><31><00>Are we getting closer to the\nend of the labyrinth...?
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><62><5f><30><30><30><34><00>A powerful enemy... But we\ncan't lose! Let's go!!
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><62><5f><30><30><31><37><00>Geez, what the heck was\nthat? It smelt weird, too.

<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><62><5f><30><30><32><31><00>I can't believe anything could\nsneeze something that big...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><38><32><31><62><5f><30><30><32><32><00>What giant of a demon\nawaits us...?
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><62><5f><30><30><32><35><00>I'm sorry, Lina. I didn't\nmean to scare you.
<fe><02><0e><73><61><76><65><5f><63><70><38><5f><30><30><30><31><00>Is there a book-loving demon?\nMaybe it's not hostile.
<fe><02><0e><73><61><76><65><5f><63><70><38><5f><30><30><30><32><00>A book-lover wouldn't leave a\nbook lying around like that.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><62><5f><30><30><34><32><00>Another magic circle... Where\ndoes this lead to?
<fe><02><0a><38><32><32><62><5f><30><30><30><30><00>All this walking, and yet still\nnothing but darkness...
<fe><02><0a><38><32><32><62><5f><30><30><31><35><00>Th-That was close... I was\nalmost eaten alive...

<fe><02><0a><38><32><32><62><5f><30><30><34><30><00>A flame from a candle stands\nout above the darkness...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><38><32><32><62><5f><30><30><34><31><00>Looks like the path\ncontinues this way.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><33><62><5f><30><30><30><34><00>Geez, is there any time\nfor us to rest?
<fe><02><0a><38><32><33><62><5f><30><30><33><39><00>I can't believe she tried\nto fight us by herself...

<fe><02><0a><38><32><33><62><5f><30><30><31><30><00>What lies ahead? What malicious\ndemon awaits us...?<fe><00><fe><02><0a><38><32><33><62><5f><30><30><31><31><00>Are we going to be able\nto defeat it?

<fe><02><0a><38><32><33><62><5f><30><30><31><32><00>Don't worry. We're much\nstronger than before.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><38><32><33><62><5f><30><30><31><33><00>We've overcome all these\nobstacles so far together.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><33><62><5f><30><30><31><37><00>Nothing to be afraid of\nif we fight together.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><33><62><5f><30><30><31><38><00>Yes... That's right. I seemed to\nforget what we've been through.

<fe><02><0a><38><32><33><62><5f><30><30><31><39><00>Intruders spotted... But their\nbonds are strong.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><38><32><33><62><5f><30><30><32><30><00>I can't fight them alone.\nI'll just let them pass.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><33><62><5f><30><30><35><37><00>I'm sure good fortune is\ncoming your way.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><33><62><5f><30><30><33><38><00>We have no choice but to fight!\nLet's do it!!
<fe><02><0a><38><32><33><62><5f><30><30><33><34><00>She has no will to fight<fc><4a>\nlet's leave her alone.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><34><62><5f><30><30><30><30><00>Is everyone alright?\nShould we rest for a bit?
<fe><02><0a><38><32><34><62><5f><30><30><30><31><00>I can't really relax in a\nplace like this.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><34><62><5f><30><30><30><37><00>I wanna go back to Riviera\nand play with everyone.

<fe><02><0a><38><32><34><62><5f><30><30><32><30><00>I'm collecting these.\nDo you guys have any?<fe><00><fe><02><0a><38><32><34><62><5f><30><30><32><31><00>If you do, I'll give you\nsomething good in return.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><34><62><5f><30><30><32><33><00>Hmm? You have a bomb.\nCan you give that to me?
<fe><02><0a><38><32><34><62><5f><30><30><32><39><00>No bombs? Then I have no\nbusiness with you.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><35><62><5f><30><30><30><39><00>Another magic circle. This\nshould lead us deep inside.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><61><5f><30><31><30><33><00>We are in a lair full\nof demons,<fe><00><fe><02><0a><38><32><31><61><5f><30><31><30><34><00>so it's best to assume demons\nare hiding everywhere.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><61><5f><30><30><38><33><00>This perfect shape and texture...\nIt looks so delicious.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><61><5f><30><30><38><34><00>How odd to find an\negg inside a chest.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><61><5f><30><30><38><37><00>Is anyone hungry?<fe><00><fe><02><0a><38><32><31><61><5f><30><30><38><38><00>I was thinking of frying this\negg. Anyone have any requests?
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><61><5f><30><30><38><39><00>Where do you get the idea\nof cooking here?
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><61><5f><30><30><39><30><00>Oh...? No one wants any? But\nfried eggs are my specialty...
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><61><5f><30><31><30><32><00>We can't let our guard down...\nEveryone, let's do it!!
<fe><02><0a><38><32><32><61><5f><30><30><30><30><00>The air is becoming more\nand more unpleasant...
<fe><02><0a><38><32><32><61><5f><30><30><30><31><00>Intruders of our realm...\nToday your life ends.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><32><61><5f><30><30><30><33><00>That means we're close to the\nend. Now let's do it!
<fe><02><0a><38><32><32><61><5f><30><30><32><38><00>Geez... That was some\ntrouble you caused us.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><32><61><5f><30><30><33><37><00>Nice throw. Not as good\nas Lina though.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><32><61><5f><30><30><36><36><00>Perhaps it's a gift for\nyour good behavior.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><33><61><5f><30><30><31><34><00>Alright, let's go. We'll go\nas far as we can.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><34><61><5f><30><30><30><38><00>I sense the amount of demons\nhere is dwindling...
<fe><02><0a><38><32><34><61><5f><30><30><30><39><00>No... There are some that are\nstill nearing us...
<fe><02><0a><38><32><34><61><5f><30><30><31><30><00>I shall take your lives\nwith this sword!
<fe><02><0a><38><32><34><61><5f><30><30><31><31><00>There are still some hiding\naround here? We have no choice!
<fe><02><0a><38><32><34><61><5f><30><30><32><30><00>It's too small for all of\nus to stand there.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><34><61><5f><30><30><33><38><00>Nothing to worry about! Come\non out, Mr. Treasure!
<fe><02><0a><38><32><34><61><5f><30><30><34><35><00>The chest is safe. I'll try\nopening it now.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><34><61><5f><30><30><35><31><00>It looks like I can open it\nwithout any worries.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><35><61><5f><30><30><30><30><00>There's no sound... This place\nfeels completely dead.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><35><61><5f><30><30><31><33><00>You shall regret setting foot\nin the land of demons.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><35><61><5f><30><30><32><31><00>At the very least, the evil\nenergy has disappeared.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><35><61><5f><30><30><32><33><00>I don't know... I've never heard\nnor read of such a monster...

<fe><02><0a><38><32><35><61><5f><30><30><32><39><00>There are no official records\nof him at Asgard...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><38><32><35><61><5f><30><30><33><30><00>But that's who I think he was.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><38><32><35><61><5f><30><30><33><31><00>Supposedly he was sealed in a\nplace no one could go...

<fe><02><0a><38><32><35><61><5f><30><30><33><39><00>No, I believe since Hades\nvanished...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><38><32><35><61><5f><30><30><34><30><00>This world is now unbalanced,\ncausing the air to bend.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><38><32><35><61><5f><30><30><34><31><00>Like when we first came here...
<fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><30><30><31><00>Do any of you remember how we\nentered this place?

<fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><30><30><35><00>But I remember the air\naround us bending...<fe><00><fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><30><30><36><00>It felt like we were entering\nanother dimension.
<fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><30><30><38><00>I don't know... We just have\nto find out ourselves...
<fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><30><31><37><00>I never imagined a creepy place\nlike this even existed...
<fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><30><32><31><00>Lina doesn't want to be\nstuck here forever!
<fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><30><32><32><00>It's okay, Lina. We will all\nreturn home together.
<fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><30><33><34><00>We were just at the underground\ncatacombs though...
<fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><30><33><35><00>What? Are we gonna be able to\nget back to Elendia?

<fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><30><33><39><00>It seems negative energy is\nsurging through the air.<fe><00><fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><30><34><30><00>I believe that is causing a\nnegative effect on our bodies.

<fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><30><34><33><00>There's no telling what'll\nhappen if we stay too long...<fe><00><fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><30><34><34><00>We need to find a way\nout of here soon.

<fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><30><35><32><00>Up ahead is something more\ndreadful than the Accursed...<fe><00><fe><02><0b><61><62><79><73><73><5f><30><30><35><33><00>That's a fact. Everyone,\nbrace yourselves.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><61><5f><30><30><30><39><00>Oh, nothing... I was just\nthinking about something.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><61><5f><30><30><31><30><00>My, my... Would you like to\ntell big sis about it?

<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><61><5f><30><30><31><33><00>I was thinking about what changes\nwe could make to magic...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><38><32><31><61><5f><30><30><31><34><00>So that it'll be useful\nto everyone.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><61><5f><30><30><31><35><00>Ein... I'm so happy that you're\nthinking about magic.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><61><5f><30><30><31><37><00>Our main problem is\nthis labyrinth.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><38><32><31><61><5f><30><30><31><38><00>I'm sorry for dragging you\nall into danger...
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><61><5f><30><30><31><39><00>My, is that what you were\nworried about?
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><61><5f><30><30><32><30><00>Finding the answer together\nis what gives it meaning.

<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><61><5f><30><30><32><39><00>Angels, Sprites, and demons...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><38><32><31><61><5f><30><30><33><30><00>I was thinking about how all of\nus could live together in peace.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><61><5f><30><30><33><31><00>It didn't look like you were\nthinking about that...
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><61><5f><30><30><33><35><00>Why do you always try to carry\nthe burden yourself?
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><61><5f><30><30><35><31><00>It doesn't hurt Lina when\nI'm with everybody.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><61><5f><30><30><35><36><00>If it helps, you can talk\nto me about it.

<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><61><5f><30><30><35><39><00>I was thinking about what\nthings we can do.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><38><32><31><61><5f><30><30><36><30><00>So the people of Elendia can\nlive in peace.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><61><5f><30><30><36><31><00>I'm glad you care about\nElendia so much.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><61><5f><30><30><36><36><00>We can overcome this ordeal\nso long as we're together.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><63><5f><30><30><30><34><00>You too... I feel relieved to\nsee your face.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><63><5f><30><30><30><36><00>Serene! I was worried sick when\nI found out we were separated.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><63><5f><30><30><30><39><00>What a relief, Lina. Good thing\nwe didn't get separated.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><63><5f><30><30><31><32><00>I'm glad to see you safe, too.\nI was worried there.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><63><5f><30><30><31><36><00>So am I... But it's still too\nearly to be at ease.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><32><61><5f><30><30><32><33><00>Like a demon's gonna just\nwaltz right out.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><32><61><5f><30><30><33><35><00>A demon... Good thing we\ndidn't get near it.

<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><63><5f><30><30><33><32><00>(We were checking the catacombs\nout, weren't we?)<fe><00><fe><02><0a><38><32><31><63><5f><30><30><33><33><00>(Then we found something, and...\nWhat happened after that?)

<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><63><5f><30><30><33><38><00>I have yet to assess
the situation...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><38><32><31><63><5f><30><30><33><39><00>But you can sense that immense
power, too, right?<fe><00><fe><02><0a><38><32><31><63><5f><30><30><34><30><00>The only thing certain is that we
are somewhere we don't belong.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><63><5f><30><30><34><35><00>I'll brush off any trouble\nthat comes our way.

<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><63><5f><30><30><34><36><00>It won't be easy getting\nout of here.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><38><32><31><63><5f><30><30><34><37><00>Ein, why don't we join forces\nuntil we escape here?
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><63><5f><30><30><35><33><00>I'm not the same as before.\nI can pull my own weight now.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><63><5f><30><30><35><34><00>You sure are confident. Then I\nlook forward to working with you.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><32><63><5f><30><30><37><31><00>There will be more enemies.\nSave your energy.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><32><63><5f><30><30><33><33><00>I can sense a mysterious power\nfrom this boulder...

<fe><02><0a><38><32><32><63><5f><30><30><33><34><00>Though weak, I can tell it is\nthe energy of a Sprite.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><38><32><32><63><5f><30><30><33><35><00>It seems a Mana Wisp is\ntrapped inside.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><32><63><5f><30><30><35><37><00>Ooh, what a strong-looking\nangel. Let's have some fun.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><32><63><5f><30><30><36><30><00>I will destroy all who get in\nmy way. Here I come!
<fe><02><0a><38><32><33><63><5f><30><30><32><37><00>It'd be trouble if the Golem\nwoke up and attacked us.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><38><32><33><63><5f><30><30><32><38><00>We should take it\nout now.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><33><63><5f><30><30><35><32><00>This is a rare opportunity.\nLet's attack the Golem!
<fe><02><0a><38><32><33><63><5f><30><30><35><33><00>We should've done that in\nthe first place.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><34><63><5f><30><30><30><35><00>Demons... The guard dog of this\nlabyrinth I see.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><34><63><5f><30><30><32><32><00>More demons might be on their\nway. Let's hurry.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><34><63><5f><30><30><32><30><00>It seems you sprung a trap\nthat alerts demons.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><34><63><5f><30><30><34><38><00>You're going to finish it off?\nA wise decision.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><34><63><5f><30><30><34><39><00>It's weakened. Now's our\nchance to defeat it!
<fe><02><0a><38><32><34><63><5f><30><30><38><39><00>Child's play... All it takes is\nobservation and calculation.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><35><63><5f><30><30><34><34><00>There are no other paths<fc><4a> what\nare you waiting for?
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><62><5f><30><30><33><34><00>It's proof of how powerful\nan enemy lies ahead.

<fe><02><0e><73><61><76><65><5f><63><70><38><5f><30><30><30><38><00>It's a Book of Memories. You\ncan record your progress here.<fe><00><fe><02><0e><73><61><76><65><5f><63><70><38><5f><30><30><30><39><00>Quite a kind thing to do,\nwhoever left this.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><62><5f><30><30><35><38><00>What are you babbling about?\nLet's continue ahead.

<fe><02><0a><38><32><33><62><5f><30><30><32><33><00>I feel malicious power growing\nstronger as we near it...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><38><32><33><62><5f><30><30><32><34><00>Are we going to be able to\ntake it on ourselves...?
<fe><02><0a><38><32><33><62><5f><30><30><32><35><00>Nonsense... A Grim Angel,\nafraid of the enemy?
<fe><02><0a><38><32><33><62><5f><30><30><32><36><00>There's nothing to fear as long\nas we have our Diviners.

<fe><02><0a><38><32><33><62><5f><30><30><32><38><00>Intruders spotted... They're...\nGrim Angels!?<fe><00><fe><02><0a><38><32><33><62><5f><30><30><32><39><00>I can't fight them alone.\nI'll just let them pass...
<fe><02><0a><38><32><33><62><5f><30><30><36><36><00>I didn't set it free hoping for\nsomething in return though.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><34><62><5f><30><30><30><38><00>Are you two okay? Should we\nrest for a bit?
<fe><02><0a><38><32><34><62><5f><30><30><33><33><00>I see a weapon in your hand...\nAre you trying to deceive us?
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><61><5f><30><31><31><30><00>This is a lair full\nof demons.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><38><32><31><61><5f><30><31><31><31><00>Assume that everything around\nus is the enemy.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><61><5f><30><30><36><39><00>Do we have time to look\ndumbfounded here?
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><61><5f><30><30><37><34><00>...What would you be without\nyour lack of experience?

<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><61><5f><30><30><37><36><00>I commend you for looking at\nyour past for faults, but...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><38><32><31><61><5f><30><30><37><37><00>Focus on how to overcome this\nsituation for now.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><61><5f><30><30><37><38><00>The answer should then come\nto you naturally.
<fe><02><0a><38><32><31><61><5f><30><31><30><39><00>(We don't even have time to\ncatch our breath.)
<fe><02><0a><38><32><32><61><5f><30><30><30><39><00>That means we're almost at\nthe depths of the labyrinth.
